tag.vi: 💅🦶 Combo: đồng bộ đi đám cưới

occasion: Your cousin's wedding is this weekend and you want matching hands and toes.
constraints: You want the mani + pedi combo, coral on hands and toes, with a few gems on your fingers and the big toes. You change your mind once about the colour (navy, then back to coral) and want the stylist to help you decide.
openingLine: Hi! I need hands and feet for a wedding this weekend. The combo, please! But I can't decide on the colour...
